evacuation-run.name: Evacuation Run
evacuation-run.brief: Punch through raiders and reach the evac signal before the line collapses.

objectives.reach-evac: Move any allied unit onto the evac flare.

crossroads-defense.name: Crossroads Defense
crossroads-defense.brief: Hold a ruined hamlet against a probing attack.

objectives.protect-bridge: Hold the central square for 4 rounds.

enemy-counterstrike.name: Hamlet Counterattack
enemy-counterstrike.brief: Enemy forces push back toward the crossroads. Hold the square until they break.

objectives.hold-square: Hold the town square for 3 rounds.

bridgehead.name: Bridgehead Raid
bridgehead.brief: Plant charges on the bridge span or rout its guard before the assault window closes.

objectives.reach-bridge: Plant charges on the bridge span.

outpost-night.name: Forward Outpost Night Raid
outpost-night.brief: Break the siege line under cover of darkness and silence enemy sorcery.

objectives.hold-relay: Secure the comms relay for 3 rounds.

black-spire-assault.name: Black Spire Assault
black-spire-assault.brief: Crash the ritual spire, break the beasts, and stop the portal ignition.

objectives.hold-spire: Hold the spire grounds for 3 rounds.
objectives.disrupt-ward: Optional: disrupt the outer ward to open an Alliance reserve corridor.

city-sector-paris.name: Paris Outskirts
city-sector-paris.brief: Cover the civilian evacuation and reach the extraction flare before the perimeter collapses.

objectives.sector-paris-reach: Escort Captain Alexander to the extraction flare.

city-sector-lyon.name: Lyon Industrial Zone
city-sector-lyon.brief: Hold the factory strongpoint against the demonic raid on the arms works.

objectives.sector-lyon-hold: Hold the central strongpoint for 3 rounds.

city-sector-strasbourg.name: Strasbourg Crossing
city-sector-strasbourg.brief: Force the Rhine: rout the bridge guard or plant charges before the assault window closes.

objectives.sector-strasbourg-reach: Plant charges at the far objective.

city-sector-munich.name: Munich Defensive Line
city-sector-munich.brief: Raid the forward line under cover of darkness and silence the enemy sorcery.

city-sector-zurich.name: Alpine Fortress
city-sector-zurich.brief: Hold the mountain pass strongpoint while the bunkers are cleared.

objectives.sector-zurich-hold: Hold the central strongpoint for 3 rounds.

city-sector-vienna.name: Vienna Siege
city-sector-vienna.brief: Break the siege of the old city: rout the besiegers and breach to the inner ring.

objectives.sector-vienna-reach: Plant charges at the far objective.

city-sector-brussels.name: Brussels Command
city-sector-brussels.brief: Reach the isolated reconnaissance team and bring it back before the headquarters perimeter falls.

objectives.sector-brussels-reach: Bring the isolated reconnaissance team back to the extraction zone.

city-sector-amsterdam.name: Amsterdam Harbor
city-sector-amsterdam.brief: Escort a supply convoy through the fog-bound canals to the forward quay.

objectives.sector-amsterdam-reach: Escort the supply convoy to the forward delivery zone.

city-sector-copenhagen.name: Copenhagen Strait
city-sector-copenhagen.brief: Hold the coastal strongpoint and deny the Baltic flanking approach.

objectives.sector-copenhagen-hold: Hold the central strongpoint for 3 rounds.

city-sector-prague.name: Prague Old Town
city-sector-prague.brief: Raid the old-town warren by night and disrupt the dark ritual.

city-sector-berlin.name: Dead Air Protocol
city-sector-berlin.brief: Trace a phantom distress network through the ruins and silence the presence speaking through every abandoned radio.

objectives.sector-berlin-eliminate: Silence the relay guard feeding the Signal-Eater.
objectives.sector-berlin-hold: Hold the dead-frequency transmitter for 3 rounds.

city-sector-warsaw.name: Warsaw Front
city-sector-warsaw.brief: Break the eastern line through the rubble and seize the far strongpoint.

objectives.sector-warsaw-reach: Plant charges at the far objective.

city-sector-krakow.name: The Glass Choir
city-sector-krakow.brief: Enter the mirrored citadel, break its resonant ward, and hold the courtyard when the silent choir answers.

objectives.sector-krakow-eliminate: Shatter the resonant guardians of the Glass Choir.
objectives.sector-krakow-hold: Hold the silent courtyard for 3 rounds.

city-sector-kyiv.name: Kyiv Siege
city-sector-kyiv.brief: Night raid through the ruined metropolis to silence the coven and hold the relay.

city-sector-carpathian.name: Carpathian Pass
city-sector-carpathian.brief: Hold the high pass strongpoint and clear the patrol-ridden ridges.

objectives.sector-carpathian-hold: Hold the central strongpoint for 3 rounds.

city-sector-blacksea.name: Black Sea Coast
city-sector-blacksea.brief: Push along the foggy coast, rout the shore-spawn and seize the far cape.

objectives.sector-blacksea-reach: Plant charges at the far objective.

city-sector-rift.name: Operation Ash Crown
city-sector-rift.brief: Cross the burning scar, anchor the seal, and survive the self-crowned warden that rises from its final breach.

objectives.sector-rift-eliminate: Bring down the wardens of the Ash Crown.
objectives.sector-rift-hold: Anchor the seal inside the burning scar for 3 rounds.
objectives.sector-rift-disrupt-ward: Optional: break the ward beacon to call Alliance rangers through the scar.

city-sector-cinder-gate.name: Cinder Gate
city-sector-cinder-gate.brief: Cross the unstable passage, break the heat-scarred pylon ring, and anchor the first Shatterline foothold.

objectives.sector-cinder-gate-eliminate: Destroy the ritual guardians around the passage.
objectives.sector-cinder-gate-hold: Hold the pylon grounds for 3 rounds.

city-sector-lantern-vault.name: Lantern Vault
city-sector-lantern-vault.brief: Reach the trapped survey team and escort its star charts out through the collapsing observatory galleries.

objectives.sector-lantern-vault-reach: Bring the survey team and its charts to the extraction zone.

city-sector-hollow-tide.name: Hollow Tide
city-sector-hollow-tide.brief: Raid the black shoreline, silence the tide-callers, and hold the stranded vanguard beacon through the mist.

objectives.sector-hollow-tide-hold: Secure the beacon ridge for 3 rounds.
